input: Enroll my parents in a digital literacy workshop

gold.taskTitle: Enroll Parents in a Digital Literacy Workshop
gold.taskDescription: Find and enroll the user's parents in a suitable digital literacy workshop that matches their needs and schedule.

questions.title: What city or region do your parents currently live in?
questions.description: Determines whether to search for in-person workshops locally or consider online options.

questions.title: Do they prefer attending in person or online?
questions.description: Narrows the format of the workshop to match their comfort and accessibility.

questions.title: What specific digital skills do they most need to learn?
questions.description: Identifies the focus area, such as smartphone use, email, video calls, or internet safety.

questions.title: What is their current level of comfort with technology?
questions.description: Helps filter workshops by beginner, intermediate, or mixed skill level.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which they need to be enrolled?
questions.description: Sets a timeline for completing the search and registration process.

questions.title: What is the maximum budget you are willing to spend?
questions.description: Filters out paid workshops that exceed the user's financial constraints.

questions.title: Will you handle enrollment yourself or do they need to register?
questions.description: Clarifies who will take action on the registration step and how much involvement the parents need.
